title: The Pöschl Tobacco Concern
content: # The Pöschl Tobacco Concern. Alois Pöschl junior and Wilhelm Pöschl, sons of Alois Pöschl, both joined their fathers’ tobacco firm in 1935, and shortly after the Second World War Alois Pöschl junior would assume the general management of the company. The said war having adversely affected not just the Pöschl concern but wider Germany, the Pöschl brothers felt the need to diversify the firms’ manufacturing output for the sake of survival, and accordingly in 1949 began to produce smoking tobaccos.2 3. With this motto, all four generations of the Pöschl family business with their highly motivated employees have shaped the business as a result of their skills and creativity, reacted to developments and trends of the consumers and thereby achieved great successes on the national and international tobacco market. After the production losses caused by World War 1 are overcome, Alois Pöschl develops a trademark for product differentiation of the Pöschl-Schmalzler around 1920 in order to stand out from the products of other manufacturers. title: What is Pöschl Tobacco? - Snustrend
content: # What is Pöschl Tobacco? Originally started as a one-man operation, Alois Pöschl quickly specialized in the production of snuff tobacco. In the post-war years, Pöschl began introducing new tobacco varieties and diversified into other areas of tobacco production. The products were distributed in more and more countries, and Pöschl Tobacco became the largest snuff tobacco manufacturer in the world. The JBR Brand from Pöschl Tobacco. Roth) brand is one of the newer brands from Pöschl Tobacco and was developed as a tribute to the long-standing tradition of snuff tobacco production. JBR stands for high-quality snuff tobacco products that impress with their unique aromas and the use of selected tobacco blends. JBR represents a modern and dynamic brand image that unites the tradition and future of snuff tobacco culture. With a clear focus on quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Pöschl Tobacco continues its success story, offering products that delight both the experienced snuff tobacco connoisseur and the curious newcomer.
